Field.name: GOutputFile
Field.usage: Output file for g transforms (optional if input name ends in xf)
Field.manpage: Output file for g transforms. If an output filename is omitted and the input filename ends in xf, the input filename will be used as output with the last letter converted from f to g.

Field.name: NumberToFit
Field.usage: Number of adjacent sections to fit, 0 for global alignment, or 1 for fit to all sections

Field.name: ReferenceSection
Field.usage: Do a global alignment to the given section (numbered from 1)
Field.manpage: Do a global alignment to the given section; this will give the reference section a unit transform and keep it from being transformed. Sections are numbered from 1.

Field.name: OrderOfPolynomialFit
Field.usage: Order of the polynomial fit to the data. The default is 1 (linear fit).

Field.name: HybridFits
Field.usage: Number of parameters to eliminate trends for with a hybrid alignment
Field.manpage: Number of parameters to eliminate trends for with a hybrid alignment: 1 for rotations only, 2 for translations only, 3 for translations and rotations, 4 for size changes also.

Field.name: RangeOfAnglesInAverage
Field.usage: Range of rotation angles for sections to include in average and fits
Field.manpage: Compute the global average center position, and the center position for local fits, using the largest group of sections whose rotation angles fall within the given range.

Field.name: RobustFit
Field.usage: Use robust weighting when fitting to find center position
Field.manpage: Use robust weighting when fitting to find the center position. The fits will be done iteratively, with a weight assigned to each point in the fit and the weight adjusted after each iteration based on the fitting error of that point. Weights are adjusted together in a fit to the four rotation/magnification parameters, and independently adjusted in a separate fit to the X and Y shift values.

Field.name: KFactorScaling
Field.usage: Amount to scale the K factor that controls how many points are down-weighted
Field.manpage: Amount to scale the K factor that controls how many points are down-weighted in the robust fitting. The default scaling of 1 gives a K factor of 4.685, the factor commonly used for the Tukey bisquare weighting. A smaller factor will down-weight and eliminate more points.

Field.name: MaximumIterations
Field.usage: Maximum iterations in robust fitting (default 200, negative for trace)
Field.manpage: The maximum number of iterations in the robust fitting. The default is 200. A negative number can be entered to obtain output about the changes in weights after each iteration.

Field.name: IterationParams
Field.usage: Max fraction with zero weights, max change in weight without and with oscillations
Field.manpage: This option sets three values that control the robust fitting: (1) The maximum fraction of points that are allowed to have zero weight. The actual limit for a particular fit is the nearest integer of this value times the number of points being fit. The default is 0.2. (2) The maximum change in weights allowed before considering that a fit has converged, if the fit is not oscillating between two states. The default is 0.02. (3) The maximum change in weights allowed for terminating the fit if it is oscillating between two states; the change in weights in one state must also be less than the maximum described in (2). The default is 0.04.
